channel.title: Korea Daily Brief
channel.description: The CSIS Korea Chair's daily brief on the Korean Peninsula, read aloud. Every item is from the printed brief, which links its sources.
channel.itunes:author: CSIS Korea Chair

item.title: Korea Daily Brief | Saturday, October 10
item.description: WPK 81st anniversary, October 10, South Korean envoy returns from Kyiv, U.S. flags alliance intel concerns, Daegu ceiling collapse 38 hurt, Kim silent day 5.

item.title: Korea Daily Brief | Friday, October 9
item.description: South Korea HGV test, Seoul recalls Ukraine envoy, NIS snub roils alliance, October 10 North Korea watch, AI cyber campaign widens.

item.title: Korea Daily Brief | Thursday, October 8
item.description: South Korea recalls Ukraine envoy over NK prisoner of war row, South Korea test-fires first hypersonic glide vehicle, AI-driven cyberattack on Korean banks, DMZ mine provocation escalates.

item.title: Korea Daily Brief | Wednesday, October 7
item.description: North Korea warns Seoul over DMZ demining, Kim letter to Putin, Nuri-5 launches 15 satellites, South Korea's 747 billion dollar energy transition.
